name: Automatic Rolls Of North Carolina (Northeast Foods)
old_description: Northeast Foods is one of the largest US suppliers of buns, rolls, and bread products and a supplier of choice for numerous fast-food chains in the country. Proud to be family-owned and operated for 4 generations and counting!
about:
Northeast Foods operates from Clayton, North Carolina, as part of the H&S Family of Bakeries, which includes H&S Bakery and Schmidt Baking Company. The business is family-owned and has been operated for four generations, tracing its roots back more than 75 years.

The company produces buns, rolls, and bread products at a scale of nearly 2 billion rolls per year across 10 bakeries and more than 30 distribution centers on the Eastern seaboard. Its portfolio includes over 250 SKUs, with capabilities for custom proprietary buns, unique recipes, and niche products developed through in-house R&D. Distribution options include fresh direct-store-delivery, FOB, and frozen shipping, supported by RFID-embedded trays and a proprietary web-based ordering platform.

Northeast Foods serves more than 100,000 customers, including major fast-food chains, quick-service restaurants, fast-casual dining establishments, supermarkets, and small businesses. It supplies both large broadline distributors and individual restaurant units.

The company emphasizes long-term partnerships, hands-on quality control, and sustainability initiatives such as packaging redesign to reduce plastic waste, LED lighting and smart HVAC to cut energy use, compressed natural gas fleet vehicles, and water recovery systems on washers.
